_comment: Authorization object of the operations framework. tools/abapgit_serialize.py writes src/<name>.suso.xml from this file (VERIFY-ADT: first pull, SU21). Object class ZCA and field ZCA_PARAR (area, data element ZCA_PARAM_AREA_ID) are the parameter framework's (param-framework/config/authorizations.json) - install ZCA_PARAM first. BUKRS (SAP standard field) restricts objects that carry a company code; area-wide checks pass it as DUMMY.
